description:
Lot of 2: The Adventures of Captain Jack #2 (September 1986) and #3 (October 1986), Fantagraphics Books. Written and drawn by Mike Kazaleh. $2.00 cover price each.

Back covers: #2 Flesh & Bones / Bojeffries Saga ad (Upshot Graphics); #3 Dalgoda ad.

Condition:
- #2: color-breaking wear and small creases along the spine edge of the front cover (see close-up); otherwise clean.
- #3: light toning/staining at the top right of the front cover and light edge wear; otherwise clean.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
